get.description: DRAFT ONLY. This route is not implemented. All reads use anonymous public eligibility, explicit projection and the privacy/withdrawal rules in the companion contract. Reject unknown or repeated query parameters. Each response meta.kind and every data.kind must agree with the requested kind. The space filter is invalid with kind=spaces. Sorting is updatedAt descending then id descending; no relevance or semantic quality guarantee.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque signed cursor, bound to route, normalized filters, limit, v1 and a ten-minute expiry. Never a snapshot or permission grant.

Space.name: space
Space.description: Public Space slug. A private or missing Space produces an empty list.

Query.name: q
Query.description: Trim before length validation; literal case-insensitive keyword matching. No regex, vector or AI expansion.

Kind.name: kind
Kind.description: One resource type per request; mixed resource search is outside v1.
